content.text: Deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free solves a critical problem for creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and other regions where Stripe, PayPal, and other conventional [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-options-ethiopian-digital-creators-minimum-viable-stack|payment]] platforms are restricted or unavailable. By leveraging GitHub Pages and NOWPayments, creators can establish ownership of their digital commerce [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/full-infrastructure-guide-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/selling-music-online-accepting-bitcoin-every-detail-you-5|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-design-assets-crypto-payments-2|The Full]] and avoid relying on third-party services that may censor or freeze their accounts. With the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), creators can scale their digital store while maintaining full control over their infrastructure and data.
Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The combination of GitHub Pages, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare Pages provides a robust infrastructure for creators to build and deploy their digital stores without relying on Stripe or other conventional payment platforms. This setup allows creators to maintain ownership of their infrastructure, data, and customer relationships, ensuring that they are not vulnerable to platform restrictions or censorship. By deploying this infrastructure, creators can establish a long-term digital presence and build a loyal customer base without worrying about platform disruptions.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your digital store, you will need to set up a GitHub account, create a GitHub Pages site, and configure a Cloudflare account. You will also need to create a Supabase account and connect it to Cloudflare Pages, as well as set up a NOWPayments account and configure it to work with your Cloudflare Pages site. Additionally, you will need to design and create your digital products, such as ebooks, courses, and templates.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you will need to configure NOWPayments to work with your Cloudflare Pages site, set up a Supabase account to store orders, and configure a Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 account to deliver files. You will also need to create a payment gateway to accept cryptocurrency payments, such as BSC, Solana, or TRON.
Deploying a digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free allows creators to establish ownership of their infrastructure and data.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

To go live, you will need to deploy your Cloudflare Pages site, configure your payment and delivery pipeline, and test your infrastructure on the mainnet. You can then process your first transaction by creating a test product, pricing it, and purchasing it using cryptocurrency. Once the transaction is processed, you can deliver the product to the customer using your Supabase and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 accounts.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

The post-deployment ownership transfer is explicit in every COREMERCH deployment. When the build is complete and the end-to-end test passes, COREMERCH provides the credentials and configuration details for every component under the customer's accounts. The GitHub or Cloudflare repository is under the customer's account from the start. The Supabase or Google Sheets database is under the customer's account. The NOWPayments account is under the customer's email. COREMERCH removes collaborator access upon delivery. From that point, the store runs entirely under the customer's own accounts.

The answer is yes, by leveraging GitHub Pages, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare Pages, you can establish ownership of your digital commerce infrastructure and avoid relying on third-party services that may censor or freeze your accounts. Your Deployment Checklist

To deploy your digital store on Cloudflare Pages for free, follow these steps: Create a GitHub account and set up a GitHub Pages site; configure a Cloudflare account and set up a Cloudflare Pages site; create a Supabase account and connect it to Cloudflare Pages; set up a NOWPayments account and configure it to work with your Cloudflare Pages site; design and create your digital products; configure a payment gateway to accept cryptocurrency payments; deploy your Cloudflare Pages site; configure your payment and delivery pipeline; test your infrastructure on the mainnet; process your first transaction; deliver your product to the customer.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the difference between Stack 01 and Stack 02 in COREMERCH?

Stack 01 is a basic infrastructure setup that includes GitHub Pages, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare Pages, while Stack 02, which includes the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), is a more advanced setup that includes Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments, and is deployed in 48 hours.
Can I host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages?
Yes, you can host a digital product store on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages, but you will need to set up a separate infrastructure for payments and delivery, such as NOWPayments and Supabase.
How do I build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free?

To build a digital store that accepts crypto payments for free, you can use the combination of GitHub Pages, NOWPayments, and Cloudflare Pages, which allows you to establish ownership of your infrastructure and data, and accept cryptocurrency payments without relying on third-party services.
What are the benefits of using NOWPayments for cryptocurrency payments?

NOWPayments provides a secure and reliable way to accept cryptocurrency payments, with a 0.5% fee and no KYC requirements, making it an ideal solution for digital creators who want to accept cryptocurrency payments without the hassle of traditional payment processors.
Can I use other cryptocurrency networks for payment processing?
Yes, you can use other cryptocurrency networks, such as BSC, Solana, or TRON, for payment processing, which can provide lower fees and faster transaction processing times.
